name: Chamber One
storyline:
You awaken inside an elevator with no memory of who you are or how you got there.
A calm system voice informs you that you are part of the Rebuild Test Program — an experiment designed to study the human mind and its integration with a digital system.

Progress through a series of carefully designed test chambers, solve environmental puzzles, and observe the world around you.
The story unfolds subtly through dialogue, atmosphere, and your own conclusion.

There are no enemies. No time pressure.
Only you, the system guiding you, and the growing sense that not everything is as it seems.
summary: Chamber One is a story-driven 3D puzzle platformer. You wake up in a sterile elevator with no memories. As part of the Rebuild Test Program, you progress through test chambers to uncover the truth about the system and yourself.
